verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals and layouts, plus Apple Shortcuts support on macOS. A script could therefore open a project workspace, but this is macOS-only. The runtime probe found no CLI remote-control or IPC interface, and nothing documents declarative session or layout definitions in config. missing for 10: config-file startup session/layout definitions, cross-platform (Linux) layout scripting, documented one-command workspace examples, hands-on corroboration of AppleScript layout scripting.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define startup sessions and window layouts in config or scripts so a project workspace opens in one command

citations.quote: Built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts, and input events.
macOS supports AppleScript, Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents), etc.
Ghostty supports multiple windows, each with its own tabs and splits.
